gate_1_swap_test.claim: the JAX bounded allocation law gives allocate()'s currents (SciPy BVLS, float64) across Navion_2's operating range, limits inactive and active, field / gradient / both, and SciPy's BVLS on the loop's force rows (scaled to order one), to the perturbation bound of least squares times 16
gate_1_swap_test.case: spike_r2/swap.py, 3000 draws (12 000 problems) per dtype, arm swap64 / swap32

prediction.value: float64 worst ratio <= 0.5, largest miss <= 1e-14 of the limit; float32 worst ratio <= 0.2, largest miss <= 2e-6 of the limit; about 60 % of problems with a coil at its limit
prediction.why: both are the exact least squares of one active set's free columns; columns scaled to unit length and QR keep float32's error at kappa eps with kappa about 4

gate_1_swap_test.metric: max over problems of |i_jax - i_ref|_inf / L over the derived bound; the residual's excess over SciPy's

control.resolution: discriminating_range.py on swap.limits_oracle (30 draws a run): predicted 1e-13 in float64, 1e-5 in float32 (the line in units of the limit)

gate_1_swap_test.if_wrong: a miss above the line with a residual below SciPy's is SciPy's (as the unscaled force rows were); one above with a residual above SciPy's is the law's: find the draw and its active set
gate_1_swap_test.cannot_discriminate_if: no draw held a coil at its limit (then only the unconstrained solve is tested): counted in with_a_coil_at_limit

gate_4_closed_loop_gradient.claim: the reverse-mode derivative of the closed-loop tracking objective in kp, ki, kd and limit equals forward mode and central differences, in float64 and float32, camera and STATE arms
gate_4_closed_loop_gradient.case: spike_r2/gradcheck.py --steps 200, the clean runs of the detection-rate arms (camera: stopb64, stopb32, edge64, edge32, freet64; STATE: state64, state32), seeds 0-19

prediction.value: every clean run exits 0 (no failure, at least one parameter discriminating) in both dtypes and arms: 20/20 each. reverse vs jvp: ratio to 16 eps N S at most 0.05 (float64) and 0.05 (float32). reverse vs central differences: ratio at most 1 on every discriminating parameter; at most 2 of 20 draws per arm have a kinked row (a limit or set change within h), passing by the kink line; in float32 ki fails to discriminate on most camera draws. float32 vs float64 derivative: relative difference under 1e-4 on dJ/dkp, dJ/dkd, dJ/dlimit
prediction.why: the loop is a piecewise-smooth program; reverse and forward take the same piece; central differences see it within h unless a kink lies within h

gate_4_closed_loop_gradient.cannot_discriminate_if: every parameter's line above a tenth of its derivative (exit 3, counted inconclusive)

gate_6_where_it_breaks.claim: where the loop's gradient stops being informative: a limit switching on, an active-set change, long runs
gate_6_where_it_breaks.case: breaks.py --sweep limit (10-40 A, 241 points) and --sweep kp (1500-3500, 201 points), camera and STATE, 200 steps; gradcheck.py at 400, 800, 1600, 3200 steps, seeds 0-2, both arms and dtypes; kd x 0.3 (camera, float64) at 400-3200

value.limit_switching: J continuous in the limit; dJ/dlimit piecewise constant-ish with a jump at every limit equal to some tick's peak demand (the number of saturated ticks changes), jumps of 20-60 % of the derivative; zero above the run's peak demand; reverse mode returns the one-sided derivative of the piece, equal to neighbour differences between kinks
value.active_set_change: dJ/dkp jumps where a tick enters or leaves saturation, a few kinks over 1500-3500, each a jump under 50 % of dJ/dkp; J continuous
value.long_runs_state: |grad J| settles (the loop is stable: the tracking error is periodic after the transient), within a factor 2 from 800 to 3200 steps; rev vs CD holds in float64; rev vs jvp ratio grows with N but stays under 1
value.long_runs_camera: the unobserved depth drifts (no z control), J and its gradient grow with N (polynomially, not exponentially) and the camera/STATE gap widens; rev vs CD holds while the drift stays inside the camera's view
value.variance: the coefficient of variation of dJ/dkp across seeds 0-2 grows with N for the camera arm, not the STATE arm
value.explosion: kd x 0.3: the loop lightly damped; |grad J| grows at least 10x from 400 to 3200 steps; float32 CD loses discrimination first
value.float32_long: float32 rev vs jvp ratio grows about linearly in N, under 1 at 3200

prediction.basis: derived; limit_switching fit to seen (STATE, 100 steps)
prediction.why: the allocation is a piecewise-smooth map of the demand, applied at discrete ticks: each tick's active set is a region in parameter space, and J is smooth inside the intersection of all ticks' regions

gate_6_where_it_breaks.cannot_discriminate_if: a sweep with no change of saturation pattern

gate_4_closed_loop_gradient.cause_found_after: the test's premise, not the law: the exact disc coverage makes J only C^(1,1/2) in a parameter (a disc's segment past a pixel side grows as depth^(3/2)), so central differences converge at order about 0.5-0.9, not 2, and the Richardson line (p = 2) was 7 times too tight; on seed 1 the ladder h .. h/16 converges monotonically to the reverse value (kp: errors 2.8e-9, 1.7e-9, 8.9e-10, 3.1e-10, 1.3e-12). Round 2 measures the order
